rows.note: Use this for a surgical procedure, rather than for any other kind of operation.

example.english: I need to have an operation next month.
example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6

rows.note: Use this for a planned police operation or military campaign; a military operation can also be made explicit by context.

example.english: The police will launch an operation tonight.
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 gam1 maan5 wui5 zin2 hoi1 haang4 dung6

rows.note: Use this for the way a device functions or operates, as in a laser being in operation.

example.english: The operation of this machine is very stable.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 ge3 wan6 zok3 hou2 wan2 ding6

rows.note: Use this when operation means the business itself or a commercial enterprise, rather than how it functions.

example.english: Their operation is doing pretty well.
example.traditional: 佢哋間舖頭嘅生意做得幾好。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ge3 saang1 ji3 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2
